source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
DataBank's Plano campus publishes 12 MW of IT capacity across 72,230 square feet of technical space. Assuming 40 kW per rack, a common density for AI training workloads, 12 MW supports roughly 300 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a more typical colocation baseline, it supports roughly 1,200 racks. The campus does not publish a power density ceiling, so which assumption applies is not determinable from the operator's own page.

The single published certification is FedRAMP. FedRAMP authorization qualifies a facility to host U.S. federal agency workloads under that program's security framework. No other certifications, such as SOC 2 or PCI DSS, appear on the specification page this site read.

Among the 133 DataBank Plano-area facilities mapped in Texas, 13 publish a megawatt figure, together totaling 389 MW of IT capacity. This campus contributes 12 of those 389 MW, placing it tenth by published IT capacity among that group. That rank reflects only what operators have chosen to publish on pages this site has read, not total installed capacity across the state.
